title: Paused Stasis
description: A surreal scene shows a young person with a split-color face standing on ancient stone ruins holding a glowing blue sword. In the background a giant cracked moon with a glowing orange-eyed face looms above a skeletal wolf-like creature with red eyes, surrounded by green smoke, colorful dripping paint, and floating orbs.
prompt: Surreal digital artwork of a young person with black hair and a face split into pink and blue sections standing on broken ancient Greek temple ruins, holding a glowing blue sword. A massive cracked moon with a humanoid face and glowing orange eyes dominates the purple sky. A skeletal black wolf with glowing red eyes stands nearby. Green smoke, colorful dripping paint effects in pink cyan and purple, floating colored orbs, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
